notes.rts.kind.worker: Unit and building names, in capitals: they sit on narrow buttons (a tiny font) and in the selection's panel.
notes.rts.kind.hall: The town hall: where workers are made and gold is carried.
notes.rts.many.worker: Several of one kind selected: {count} is 2 or more.
notes.rts.many.hall: Several halls selected ({count}, 2 or more). The English keeps the singular here; use your language's own plural.
notes.rts.many.stable: Several stables selected ({count}, 2 or more). The English keeps the singular here; use your language's own plural.
notes.rts.many.mixed: Several units of different kinds selected.
notes.rts.cmd.amove: Attack-move: the selected units walk to a point, fighting whatever they meet. A button in a tiny font: keep it short.
notes.rts.cmd.stop: A button: the selected units stop.
notes.rts.say.attacked: {kind} is one of your buildings (HALL, BARRACKS, STABLE).
notes.rts.say.amove.touch: After A-MOVE: tap the point the army fights its way to.
notes.rts.say.on_way: {kind} is the building ordered; a worker walks there to build it.
notes.rts.say.arming: The Ash Clan is the enemy, across the river.
notes.rts.banner: The match's title: the war of the Vale (the player's side) against the Ash Clan.
notes.rts.hud.people: Your units now and the most you may have.
notes.rts.hud.making_more: {more}: how many more wait after this one.
notes.rts.hud.going_up: A building being built: how far along it is.
notes.rts.place.place: Touch buttons while placing a building: put it here, or cancel.
notes.rts.side.idle: A touch button: select a worker with nothing to do.
notes.rts.hint: Key help, tiny font: {key:base} and {key:army} are the keys that select the hall and the army.
notes.rts.over.time: {time}: the match's length (m:ss); {gold}: the gold your workers mined.
notes.rts.over.stats: Units made, units lost, enemies killed.
notes.action.order: On the controls screen: the button that orders the selected units (move, attack, gather).
notes.action.cmd1: On the controls screen: the key for the panel's first command (Cmd: command).
notes.action.cmd2: The key for the panel's second command.
notes.action.cmd3: The key for the panel's third command.
notes.action.base: The key that selects your town hall and shows it.
notes.action.army: The key that selects your whole army.
notes.action.alert: The key that shows where the last attack came.
notes.action.amove: The key for attack-move (the units fight their way to a point).

brief: The RTS slice: a real-time strategy match in the manner of Warcraft II and Command & Conquer. The player leads the Vale (workers, footmen, archers, knights, a hall, barracks and a stable) against the Ash Clan across a river, and wins by burning the clan's camp. Its HUD, buttons and alerts are terse military capitals, like a 1990s RTS; buttons are narrow, in a tiny font, so keep their words short.
